title: A lane posts a review round's record before any push to its PR branch, a base merge included
why: A lane pushed a base merge before it printed a review round's record, so the record could not name the reviewed head (coordinator, 04:26 CST Nov 8). Step record-before-fix-push covers a fix push after a passing round only.
note: Fix: the push guard asks on any push to a PR branch whose newest review round has no posted record, a base-merge push included. Red case first: a base-merge push before the record passes today; control: a push after the record is posted passes. Related steps record-before-fix-push (#1538) and record-after-each-round. Lane [ended:lane:-silent-undo-checks-pr-base]. Queue fix. Filed 04:30 CST Nov 8. Sighting (lane builder-report-in-head, 06:58 CST Nov 8; filed as record-before-later-push, folded here): the lane pushed after review passed and before the record was posted; merge --review-record records only the live head, so the record could not be written, and nothing stopped the push. Four more sightings, one mistake (a fix pushed before the failed round's record was posted, so the tool could not record the old head): #1985 (lane notes-fix-other-2), #1699 (lane sim-lease-gaps), #1914 at 05:06 CST (lane notes-fix-large-3; proposed post-fail-record-first, folded here), and #1958's rounds. Coordinator, 07:43 CST Nov 8: one home, no second step review-record-past-head. Two more sightings, folded here at 09:44 CST Nov 8 (triage had filed them as a duplicate step, record-at-round-head, now removed): lane bg-tail-loses-verdict on #2015 and #2025 (round 3 not recorded at its head before fixes landed, so `merge --review-record --fix-check` refused; harm: runner 8 gets a record it may not parse, or a lane fakes the head); lane notes-fix-report on #2026 and #2068 at 09:40 CST (a fresh chain of three rounds followed). Second guard idea from bg-tail: `--fix-check` takes the reviewed head named in the reviewer's report; that touches step fix-check-chain. Doing 09:45 CST Nov 8 in its own lane, [ended:Lane:-review-record-before-any-push], branching from #1538's head (coordinator, 09:45 CST); [ended:lane:-silent-undo-checks-pr-base] keeps silent-undo only. Sighting (lane time-from-one-helper, #2153, via coordinator 11:19 CST Nov 8): a records commit pushed after round 3 and before the review record made the merge tool refuse the record, and a fresh round 3 re-read the new head. Proposed fix: the operating-model template says to post the record before any push after the last round. Sighting (coordinator, 04:54 CST Nov 9): a lane pushed fixes before posting its first round 1 record. Proposed: `merge --fix-check` reminds a lane to post the record first. Coordinator 09:54 CST Nov 9 (asked as a new step record-before-push, folded here): seen 3 times today, #2435, #2447 and #2436's earlier fix check; each lane then paid a fresh full round 3. Fix options: the guard refuses a push to a PR branch while the newest review round in the lane's transcript has no posted record for its head (any verdict, wider than step record-before-fix-push, which asks only after a passed round); or merge --review-record gains a form that records a round at an older head plus a fix check up to the live head, if decision pr-review-record allows it. Red case first. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was [ended:Lane:-review-record-before-any-push]).
